summary: Zions Bancorporation filed an 8-K reporting the sale of 460,153 Class B-1 shares of Visa Inc. on May 4, 2026, for $215 million in aggregate proceeds, generating a pre-tax gain of approximately the same amount in Q2 2026. The shares were originally received in 2007 from a Visa restructuring and IPO. No board recommendation, advisors, premium, or deal mechanics are disclosed as this is a portfolio asset sale, not a corporate action. Watch for any subsequent disclosures on capital deployment of the gain; no risk-arb angle applies.
